items.title: Eddie Marshall interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: So if I wrote a song that was in 7/8 and I’d say, “Andre just go like this” [scats], he didn’t count, he would just do it.

ctx.x: Sure. Yeah that can be funny sometimes, hearing straight jazz people trying to play some rock & roll.

I know it. Because I tried to play in their band and they’re all over me and we had a little hip hop band together. And none of them — Al plays drums, my oldest son. But he wanted to play keys, but he played everything. So I played with them for a while. And I can do it for a while, and I can keep the pocket going, but I’ve got to always put something extra — so I’d be like [scats] and as soon as I did it they turned around. And I said oh man, forget it. But they really still are good musicians, those kids, they…
